#!/system/bin/sh
ADB_SERIAL='AVNS023705001888'
TARGET_USER='0'
for PACKAGE in \
  com.eg.android.AlipayGphone \
  com.coolapk.market \
  com.twitter.android \
  com.bilibili.app.in
do
  adb -s "$ADB_SERIAL" shell cmd appops set --user "$TARGET_USER" "$PACKAGE" RUN_ANY_IN_BACKGROUND default
  adb -s "$ADB_SERIAL" shell dumpsys deviceidle whitelist +"$PACKAGE"
done

#!/system/bin/sh
ADB_SERIAL='AVNS023705001888'
TARGET_USER='0'
for PACKAGE in \
  com.hihonor.detectrepair \
  com.hihonor.android.projectmenu \
  com.hihonor.mmitest \
  com.hihonor.hnstartupguide
do
  adb -s "$ADB_SERIAL" shell pm default-state --user "$TARGET_USER" "$PACKAGE"
done
adb -s "$ADB_SERIAL" shell pm list packages -d --user "$TARGET_USER"
